blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Boundary representation (B-Rep) of CAD models encodes geometric primitives and their relations as a graph structure, enabling efficient shape modeling within CAD software. Learning on B-Reps for downstream tasks, such as segmentation and novel shape generation, requires specialized neural network designs. Moreover, performance improvements and accelerated training can be achieved with effective pretraining strategies, which is particularly important for tasks with limited labeled B-Rep data. In this paper, we introduce BRepA, a unified self-supervised pretraining framework that explicitly reconstructs both the geometry and topology of B-Rep objects via graph-based modeling. By learning from large-scale unlabeled CAD data only once, BRepA produces representations that generalize across tasks and significantly enhance both discriminative and generative learning. On segmentation tasks, BRepA demonstrates remarkable data efficiency. For instance, with only 1% labeled samples, BRepA pretraining improves mIoU by 32.52% compared to models trained from scratch. On generative tasks, aligning diffusion model representations with pretrained BRepA features substantially accelerates convergence, achieving nearly 2 times faster training while improving generation quality under the same computational budget, despite the diffusion model being roughly 20 times larger than BRepA. Overall, our results show that geometry- and topology-aware B-Rep pretraining provides a powerful foundation for both understanding and generating CAD structures, serving as a versatile representation backbone for diverse downstream applications. We will release the code to facilitate future research.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Boundary representation (B-Rep) is a fundamental CAD data format that encodes both the geometric and topological structure of 3D objects [ 15 , 19 ] .
The geometric information describes the parametric characteristics of surfaces, edges, and vertices, while the topological information defines both inter-type relationships (e.g., which edges bound a face) and intra-type adjacencies ( e.g . , neighboring faces or edges).
B-Rep is widely used in industrial design and manufacturing workflows for visualization, machining feature management, and engineering analysis.

blocks.en:
Despite its importance, training B-Rep models presents unique challenges. Models like UV-Net [ 15 ] , BRepNet [ 19 ] and SB-GCN [ 16 ] are examples of neural network architectures operating on B-Reps. Compared to 2D images or 3D data [ 39 , 40 , 41 ] , the amount of publicly available B-Rep data is limited, and labeled datasets are particularly scarce, making B-Rep models prone to overfitting on small datasets [ 17 ] .
Moreover, B-Rep is a parametric and symbolic representation, which is highly abstract and discrete in the feature space.
This discrete and fragmented data manifold makes it especially challenging to train generative models such as diffusion models [ 12 ] , which typically rely on continuous and smooth spaces.
blocks.zh:
尽管培训具有重要性,但B-Rep模式提出了独特的挑战。 UV-Net [15],BrepNet [19]和SB-GCN [16]等模型都是在B-Reps上运行的神经网络架构的例子. 相较于2D图像或3D数据[39,40,41],可公开获取的B-Rep数据数量有限,被贴上标签的数据集尤其稀缺,使得B-Rep模型容易在小数据集上被过度调整[17].
此外,B-Rep是一种参数化和象征性的表示,在特征空间中是高度抽象和离散的.
这种离散和零散的数据多面性使得训练遗传模型,如通常依赖连续和平滑空间的传播模型[12],尤其具有挑战性.

blocks.en:
A promising strategy to address these challenges is self-supervised pretraining, where models are trained on available unlabeled B-Rep data to learn generalizable representations, which can then be fine-tuned or aligned for downstream tasks.
However, research in this direction remains limited.
To our knowledge, only [ 17 , 28 , 29 ] have explored self-supervised pretraining on B-Rep data, and its effectiveness has been evaluated only on discriminative tasks.
blocks.zh:
应对这些挑战的一个有希望的战略是进行自我监督的预训,对模型进行未加标签的B-Rep数据的培训,以学习通用的表述,然后可以对下游任务进行微调或调整。
然而,这方面的研究仍然有限。
据我们所知,只有[17,28,29]探索了B-Rep数据方面的自我监督预训,其效力仅被评价于歧视性任务.

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduce BRepA , a new B-Rep pretraining model designed to learn both geometric and topological representations.
BRepA naturally models B-Rep data as graphs by using Graph Attention models (GAT) [ 31 ] and adopts Transformer-based encoders for both surfaces and edges.
It jointly learns geometry- and topology-aware representations through two complementary pretraining objectives: Geometry Masked Autoencoding (MAE) and Topology MAE .
Our experiments demonstrate that the learned representations from BRepA benefit both discriminative and generative tasks: (1) In segmentation tasks, pretrained BRepA consistently outperforms both untrained BRepA and UV-Net, particularly in low-label regimes, as depicted in Figure 1 (a). (2) In generative tasks, BRepA enables faster and more effective training of large-scale generative models such as BrepDiff [ 21 ] through feature alignment, improving both training efficiency and final generation quality, as depicted in Figure 1 (b), even though these diffusion-based models contain far more parameters than BRepA itself.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们引入了BrepA,一个新的B-Rep预训模型,旨在学习几何和地貌表现.
BREPA通过使用Graph Note模型(GAT)[31]自然地将B-Rep数据作为图表,并为表面和边缘都采用以变形器为基础的编码器.
它通过两个互补的预培训目标,共同学习几何和地貌方面的表现: 几何面罩自动编码(MAE)和地理学(Topology MAE).
我们的实验表明,从BREPA学到的表述既有利于歧视性的任务,也有利于遗传性的任务: (1) 在分区任务中,如图1(a)所示,经过预先训练的BREPA一贯优于未经训练的BREPA和UV-Net,特别是在低标签制度中。 (2) 在遗传性任务中,BrepDiff[21]等大型遗传性模型通过特征对接,提高了培训效率和最终生成质量,如图1(b)所描述的那样,BrepDiff[21]使得这些基于传播的模型包含的参数远多于BrepA本身.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Self-supervised learning (SSL) has become a powerful strategy for learning transferable representations without manual annotations [ 11 , 5 , 4 , 13 ] .
DINO-v2 [ 27 ] further demonstrates that large-scale SSL can produce semantically rich features that generalize across downstream tasks.
Recent Representation Alignment (REPA) shows that aligning diffusion model features with DINO-v2 representations accelerates convergence and improves generation quality [ 37 ] .
SSL on B-Reps has been studied in [ 17 , 28 , 29 ] . [ 28 , 29 ] focus on global retrieval, while [ 17 ] addresses segmentation via geometric reconstruction.
Yet, [ 17 ] only reconstructs corrupted surface features and does not explicitly capture topological relationships.
blocks.zh:
自我监督的学习(SSL)已成为学习可转移表述的强大战略,没有人工说明[11,5,4,13].
DINO-v2 [27] 进一步证明,大规模SSL能够产生出通向下游任务通俗化的丰富特征.
最近的表述对接(REPA)表明,将扩散模型特征与DINO-v2的表述相匹配可加速趋同并改进生成质量[37].
B-Reps上的SSL在[17,28,29]被研究. [28,29]侧重于全球检索,而[17]则通过几何重建处理分块.
然而,[17]只重建了腐烂的地表地貌特征,并没有明确地捕捉出地貌关系.

blocks.en:
B-Rep segmentation is a fundamental task in CAD understanding, aiming to assign semantic or functional labels to surfaces or faces within B-Rep models [ 38 , 2 , 15 , 18 , 20 , 6 , 25 ] .
Two widely used datasets for this task are Fusion 360 Segmentation [ 32 ] and MFCAD [ 3 ] , which provide annotated B-Rep models of mechanical parts, enabling the development and evaluation of learning-based methods. Early approaches such as SB-GCN employed hierarchical graph convolutional networks to jointly encode geometric and topological information [ 16 ] , while UV-Net introduced a hybrid architecture combining convolutional and graph-based encoders to better capture both local surface geometry and global connectivity [ 15 ] .
blocks.zh:
B-Rep分解是CAD理解中的一项基本任务,旨在为B-Rep模型中的表面或面相分配语义或功能标签[38,2,15,18,20,6,25].
用于这一任务的两个被广泛使用的数据集是Fusion 360 Specation [32]和MFCAD [3],它们提供了附加说明的B-Rep机械部件模型,能够开发和评价以学习为基础的方法. SB-GCN等早期方法采用分级图演化网络,联合编码几何和地理学信息[16];而UV-Net则引入了混合结构,结合了分级和以图为主的编码器,以更好地捕捉地表几何和全球连接[15].

blocks.en:
B-Rep generation has become an active direction in neural CAD, aiming to reconstruct B-Reps from geometric inputs or synthesize them from learned distributions [ 33 , 10 , 14 ] .
Recent methods largely build on diffusion models [ 12 , 26 , 9 , 35 ] , following either cascade or one-step inference method.
Cascade methods such as BrepGen [ 34 ] progressively generate surface and edge bounding boxes and latent features, which are then decoded into complete B-Rep structures.
In contrast, one-step methods such as BrepDiff [ 21 ] directly generate surface UV-grid coordinates and visibility masks, followed by post-processing to recover B-Reps.
Other works further explore holistic latent representations and alternative diffusion formulations for B-Rep synthesis [ 24 , 22 , 23 ] .
blocks.zh:
B-Rep生成已成为神经CAD的积极方向,旨在从几何输入重建B-Reps,或从所学的分布[33,10,14]合成.
最近的方法主要以传播模型[12、26、9、35]为基础,采用级联法或一步推论法。
BrepGen [34]等连锁方法逐渐生成地表和边缘接合箱和潜伏特征,再被解码为完整的B-Rep结构.
相形之下,BrepDiff [21]等单步方法直接生成地表紫外线网坐标和能见度口罩,再进行后处理以恢复B-Reps.
其他工作进一步探讨B-Rep合成[24、22、23]的整体潜在表达和替代扩散配方。

blocks.en:
In this section, we first provide the preliminaries on B-Rep data representation.
Next, we introduce the architecture of BRepA, including the surface, edge, and graph encoders,
as well as its dual masked autoencoding pretraining scheme on both geometric and topological levels.
Finally, we describe how BRepA is utilized for training both discriminative and generative models.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们首先提供关于B-Rep数据表示的初步说明。
接下来,我们介绍BREPA的架构, 包括地表,边缘和图形编码器,
及其在几何和地貌两个层面的双重蒙面自动编码预训计划。
最后,我们描述了如何利用BREPA培训歧视性和遗传性模型。

blocks.zh: 3.1 初步情况

We follow the UV-Net representation [ 15 ] for B-Rep geometry, where the geometry of a curve C ⁡ ( u ) C(u) is discretized over its parametric domain [ u min , u max ] ∈ ℝ [u_{\min},u_{\max}]\in\mathbb{R} into a regular 1D grid with a uniform step size δ u = u max − u min M − 1 \delta_{u}=\frac{u_{\max}-u_{\min}}{M-1} , where M M is the number of sampled points.

blocks.en: 3.2 BRepA Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.2 布雷帕语 建筑

blocks.en:
The encoding of B-Rep involves processing surface features 𝐱 s \mathbf{x}_{s} , edge features 𝐱 e \mathbf{x}_{e} , and the graph G ⁡ ( V , E ) G(V,E) .
In our BRepA framework, as shown in Figure 2 , we follow the design architecture of ConViT [ 8 ] , which combines convolutional and transformer-based modules to perform local and global level modeling, respectively.
This hybrid design leverages the lightweight advantage of CNNs for efficient local feature extraction and the superior global awareness of Vision Transformers [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh:
B-Rep的编码涉及处理地表特征 x s\ mathbf{x}_{s},边缘特征 x e\mathbf{x}_{e},以及图G ⁡ (V, E) G (V, E).
如图2所示,在我们BRepA框架内,我们遵循ConViT[8]的设计架构,该架构结合了以革命为主和以变压器为基础的模块,分别进行局部和全球一级的建模.

blocks.zh: 3.4 一个预先训练,两个领域

blocks.en:
Once BRepA is pretrained, the learned representations 𝐟 \mathbf{f} can be effectively utilized across various downstream tasks.
In this work, we demonstrate the benefits of BRepA in two representative categories: segmentation and generative modeling.
Specifically, we evaluate how BRepA accelerates convergence and improves performance in both scenarios.
blocks.zh:
BRepA一旦经过了预先训练,就可以在下游各种任务中有效地利用学到的表示f\mathbf{f}.

具体地说,我们评价BREPA在两种情景中如何加速趋同和改善业绩。

blocks.en:
For segmentation tasks, we attach a lightweight four-layer MLP seg \mathrm{MLP}_{\text{seg}} as a segmentation prediction head on top of the pretrained BRepA encoder.
The model is then fine-tuned using the available labeled samples, with the multi-class cross-entropy loss ℒ s ​ e ​ g \mathcal{L}_{seg} as the training objective, as depicted in Figure 4 (a).
Essentially, BRepA provides a well-initialized representation space that mitigates overfitting and stabilizes the optimization of the segmentation network.
In our experiments, we show that this simple BRepA-based segmentation model consistently outperforms UV-Net [ 15 ] with a comparable number of parameters.

在我们的实验中,我们显示,这种基于BREPA的简单分解模型以可比的参数一直超过UV-Net[15].

For generative training, we employ the pretrained representation 𝐟 \mathbf{f} from BRepA to guide the intermediate features of a B-Rep diffusion model, thereby accelerating its training process, as depicted in Figure 4 (b).
Following the design in [ 37 ] , Representation Alignment (REPA) is performed on the early stacked transformer layers within the diffusion model to enforce representation consistency.
Specifically, for the first K K transformer layers, we extract their intermediate outputs and apply average pooling to obtain the hidden feature 𝐨 k , i \mathbf{o}_{k,i} for surface i i , where k k denotes the layer index.

In this section, we first describe the experimental setup, including the datasets, training details, and evaluation metrics.
Next, we demonstrate the impact of BRepA pretraining on segmentation training, particularly when the number of labeled samples is limited.
We then show how BRepA benefits the B-Rep generation model, BrepDiff [ 21 ] , in terms of both training speed and final performance.
Finally, we investigate the effect of BRepA’s model size.

在本节中,我们首先描述实验设置,包括数据集,培训细节和评价度量衡.
其次,我们展示了BREPA预训对分化培训的影响,特别是在标有标签的样品数量有限的情况下。
然后我们展示BRepA在训练速度和最终性能两方面如何受益B-Rep生成模型BrepDiff [21].
最后,我们调查BREPA模型尺寸的影响。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We conduct experiments on two public B-Rep datasets, MFCAD [ 3 ] and Fusion 360 Segmentation [ 32 ] .
MFCAD provides 16 machining-feature categories, while Fusion 360 contains 8 face-level modeling-operation categories.
Following the official trainval/test splits, we use 12367/3094 samples for MFCAD and 30459/5399 for Fusion 360.
For segmentation, we randomly sample 0.1%, 0.2%, 0.5%, 1%, 10%, 20%, and 50% of the training set as labeled subsets; for generation, we use the full training set.

在正式的列车站/测试分出后,我们使用12367/3094的样品用于MFCAD和30459/5399的Fusion 360.

For the pretraining of BRepA, we train the model for 1,000 epochs using an NVIDIA A6000 GPU with 48GB VRAM.
The checkpoint with the lowest pretraining loss ℒ M ​ A ​ E \mathcal{L}_{MAE} on the validation set is selected for the subsequent segmentation and generation experiments.
Training on the MFCAD dataset converges to the optimal checkpoint in approximately 2 hours, while training on the Fusion 360 dataset takes around 6 hours.

blocks.en:
For the generative task, we adopt BrepDiff [ 21 ] as the base diffusion model and use its official implementation and training configurations as our baseline.
In addition, following the feature alignment strategy described in Section 3.3 ,
we align the outputs of the first four transformer layers (out of twelve) in BrepDiff [ 21 ] with the pretrained representations from BRepA.

我们把布雷普迪夫的前4个变压器层(共12个变压器层)的输出值与BrepDiff[21]的预加训练的表示值一致.

blocks.en:
The mIoU results of BRepA and the baseline models on MFCAD and Fusion 360 are reported in Tables 1 and 2 , respectively, while the accuracy results are presented in Figures 5 and 6 . Across all label ratio settings, full BRepA training consistently achieves the best performance on both mIoU and accuracy. Moreover, the benefits of BRepA pretraining are particularly pronounced when labeled data are scarce: with only 1% of MFCAD labeled, BRepA pretraining improves mIoU by 32.52% , and with only 0.5% of Fusion 360 labeled, it improves mIoU by 13.63% . In addition, the advantages of BRepA (w/o SSL) over UV-Net++ highlight the effectiveness of novel modules such as Transformer layers and GAT compared to using only CNNs and vanilla GCNs.
Focusing solely on geometry MAE, the performance gains brought by BRepA’s geometry MAE are significantly larger than those from SDF SSL [ 17 ] ; moreover, the inclusion of topology MAE in BRepA further improves the model’s performance.

Adopting the default training method and the training augmented with BRepA-based feature alignment, the generative performance of BrepDiff [ 21 ] is reported in Table 3 .
On both the MFCAD [ 3 ] and Fusion 360 [ 32 ] datasets, incorporating BRepA consistently improves the generation quality.
For example, in terms of 1-NNA, BRepA brings gains of 3.3% and 3.5% on the two datasets, respectively.
Importantly, the benefit of BRepA in accelerating training is particularly significant. As is well known, diffusion models [ 12 ] are computationally expensive to train; however, BRepA effectively alleviates this issue.
During training, we perform validation every 50 epochs by generating samples and computing 1-NNA, COV, and MMD. The evolution of these metrics over training epochs is shown in Figure 1 (b), 8 , and 9 .
All three figures consistently demonstrate that integrating BRepA leads to a substantial acceleration in BrepDiff training, allowing it to reach strong performance using nearly half the training time, while also improving the final convergence quality, as reflected by better 1-NNA and COV results.
It is worth noting that the default BRepA model contains only 13.5M parameters, whereas BrepDiff has roughly 260M parameters, almost 20x larger.
The fact that such a compact model can substantially accelerate a generative model far larger than itself highlights the strong generalization of the representations learned by BRepA pretraining.

blocks.en: 4.3 Experimental Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 实验分析

blocks.en:
For deep learning models, larger parameter sizes often correlate with stronger capacity and improved performance.
Under the default configuration, BRepA contains only 13.5M parameters. To investigate the effect of model scaling, we increase the dimensionality of intermediate features, the number of attention heads, and the Transformer layers to construct two larger variants: BRepA-L (27M) and BRepA-XL (80M) .
Importantly, we scale the surface, edge, and graph encoders uniformly; increasing the capacity of only a single module leads to unstable training. We evaluate both BRepA-L and BRepA-XL on the MFCAD dataset, and the results are reported in Table 4 .
As observed from Table 4 , scaling up BRepA consistently improves mIoU across all label ratios. In particular, the largest variant, BRepA-XL, achieves the highest mIoU values for all label ratios, indicating that increasing model capacity allows for better feature representation and stronger generalization.
blocks.zh:
对于深层学习模型来说,更大的参数大小往往与更强的能力和更好的业绩有关。
在默认配置下,BrepA只包含13.5M参数. 为了调查模型缩放的效果,我们增加了中间特征的维度,注意头的数量,以及变形器层来构建出两个更大的变体:BREPA-L (27M)和BREPA-XL (80M).
重要的是,我们统一标出表面、边缘和图形编码器;只增加一个模块的能力会导致培训不稳定。 我们对MFCAD数据集的BREPA-L和BREPA-XL都进行了评估,结果见表4。
如表4所示,扩大BREPA的规模,在所有标签比率上不断提高mIoU。 特别是,最大的变种BREPA-XL实现所有标签比的最高mIoU值,表明模型容量的提高可以使特性表现更好,并更能被概括.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we introduced BRepA, a unified self-supervised pretraining framework that addresses B-Rep CAD learning challenges through dual masked autoencoding of geometric and topological information. Our experiments demonstrate substantial improvements across both discriminative and generative tasks, achieving 32.52% mIoU improvement with only 1% labeled samples and accelerating diffusion model training by nearly 2× despite being 20× smaller. The success stems from our novel architecture combining Vision Transformers for geometric features with Graph Attention Networks for topological modeling, enabling effective cross-domain generalization. Overall, BRepA establishes a powerful foundation for CAD AI systems, demonstrating that geometry- and topology-aware pretraining provides a versatile backbone for both efficient generative model training and improved discriminative performance with limited labels.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们引入了BrepA,这是一个统一的自我监督的预训框架,通过对几何和地理学信息的双重蒙面自编码来解决B-Rep CAD学习挑战. 我们的实验表明,在歧视性和遗传性任务方面都有了很大的改进,只用1%的标有标签的样品就实现了32.52%的MIOU改进,尽管规模较小,但传播模型培训却加快了将近2×。 之所以成功,是因为我们的新建筑将几何特征的 " 视觉变形器 " 与地形模型化的 " 图表关注网络 " 结合起来,从而能够有效地实现跨域的通用。 总体而言,BrepA为CADAI系统奠定了强大的基础,表明几何和地貌意识预训为高效的基因模型培训提供了多功能的骨干,并用有限的标签改善了歧视性能.

blocks.en: B Additional Experimental Details and Results
blocks.zh: B. 其他实验细节和结果

blocks.en: B.1 Few-Shot Classification with BRepA
blocks.zh: B.1 与BREPA一起的 " 少数热 " 分类

blocks.en: In the main text, we present the utility of BRepA for discriminative tasks by demonstrating its substantial impact on segmentation performance. To further illustrate its broad applicability, we evaluate BRepA on another discriminative task: classification. We conduct experiments on the SolidLetters [ 15 ] dataset under highly challenging 1-, 2-, and 5-shot settings. The experimental results, as summarized in Table 5 , further confirm the effectiveness of BRepA across diverse discriminative scenarios.
blocks.zh: 在正文中,我们通过展示BREPA对分化性能的重大影响,介绍了BREPA对歧视性任务的效用. 为了进一步说明其广泛适用性,我们评价BREPA的另一项歧视性任务:分类。 我们在极具挑战性的1-、2-和5-镜头设置下对SolidLeters[15]数据集进行实验。 如表5所总结的实验结果进一步证实了BREPA在各种歧视情景中的有效性。

blocks.en: Table 5 : Few-shot classification accuracy (%) on the SolidLetters dataset. BRepA consistently enhances performance across all settings, demonstrating its strong generalization as a discriminative feature extractor.
blocks.zh: 表5: SolidLeters 数据集上的几发准确分类率(%)。 BREPA持续增强所有环境的性能,显示出它作为歧视特征提取器的强烈概括.

blocks.en: B.2 Robustness of BRepA across Different Generative Architectures and Datasets
blocks.zh: B.2 不同基因结构和数据集的BREPA坚固性

blocks.en: In the main text, we demonstrated that BRepA significantly accelerates the training of the B-Rep generative model BrepDiff [ 21 ] . Here, we further show that BRepA similarly enhances the training efficiency of another B-Rep generative model, BrepGen [ 34 ] , thereby highlighting the robust generalization capability of BRepA in accelerating the training of generative models. BrepGen employs separate Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) for surfaces and edges; accordingly, we align BRepA features with each of these components. The validation noise curves for these two LDMs during training are illustrated in Fig. 10 , indicating that both LDMs achieve noticeably faster convergence.
blocks.zh: 在正文中,我们证明了BREPA大大地加速了B-Rep基因模型BrepDiff的训练[21]. 在此,我们进一步表明,BrepA同样提高了另一个B-Rep基因模型BrepGen[34]的培训效率,从而凸显出BrepA在加速基因模型培训方面的强通化能力. BrepGen对地表和边缘分别使用Lentnt扩散模型(LDMs);因此,我们使BrepA特性与每个组件相配合。 图10显示了这两个LDM在训练期间的验证噪声曲线,表明这两个LDM都显著地实现了更快的汇合.

blocks.en: Figure 10 : Loss curves for the Surface LDM (a) and Edge LDM (b) during the training of BrepGen. The results demonstrate that integrating BRepA leads to significantly faster convergence across both generative components.
blocks.zh: 图10:BrepGen培训期间地表LDM(a)和Edge LDM(b)的损失曲线。 结果显示,整合BREPA将大大加快两个基因组组成部分的融合。

blocks.en: Additionally, we select MFCAD and Fusion 360 in the manuscript because they provide native segmentation labels, allowing us to demonstrate that pretrained BRepA can be effectively applied to both understanding and generation tasks. To address generalization to more complex B-Rep distributions, we additionally evaluate BRepA on the larger and more diverse ABC [ 18 ] dataset. As shown in Figure 11 , BRepA substantially accelerates the training of BrepDiff on ABC.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们在手稿中选择了MFCAD和Fusion 360,因为它们提供了本土分块标签,使我们能够证明预先训练的BREPA可以有效地应用于理解和生成任务. 为了将一般化到更复杂的B-Rep分布,我们进一步评价了BREPA在更大更多样化的ABC[18]数据集. 如图11所示,BREPA大大地加快了BrepDiff在ABC上的训练.

blocks.en: Figure 11 : Training convergence of BrepDiff on ABC. Pretrained BRepA accelerates convergence and improves the 1-NNA metric, demonstrating its generalization to diverse B-Rep distributions.
blocks.zh: 图11:BreepDiff关于ABC的培训趋同。 被预先训练的BRepA加速了收缩,并改进了1-NNA的度量衡,显示了它向多样的B-Rep分布的概括.

blocks.en: B.3 Effect of Mask Ratio
blocks.zh: B.3 面具比率的影响

blocks.en:
In the dual-MAE pretraining of BRepA, we randomly mask either surface nodes or edges in the B-Rep graph.
In this experiment, we investigate how different masking strengths affect the pretraining effectiveness of BRepA.
blocks.zh:
在BrepA的双MAE预训中,我们随机地在B-Rep图中遮住表面节点或边缘.
在这个实验中,我们调查不同遮掩的长处如何影响BREPA的预训效果.

blocks.en:
For light masking, at each iteration we sample a mask ratio m % m\% from a uniform distribution [ 0 , 0.2 ] [0,0.2] and randomly mask m % m\% of the surface nodes and edges.
Similarly, for medium and heavy masking, we sample m % m\% from [ 0 , 0.5 ] [0,0.5] and [ 0 , 0.8 ] [0,0.8] , respectively.
We conduct repeated experiments on the MFCAD [ 3 ] dataset under the {0.5%, 1%, 10%} label-ratio settings. The results are reported in Fig. 12 .
blocks.zh:
对于光遮罩,在每次迭接时,我们从一个统一的分布[0,0.2] [0,0.2]和随机遮罩的表面节点和边缘上抽取出一个口罩相比为%.
同样,对于中重口罩,我们从[0、0.5] [0、0.5]和[0、0.8][0、0.8]分别抽取 m%.。
我们在{0.5%,1%,10}标签-ratio设置下对 MFCAD [3] 数据集进行重复实验. 图12报告了结果。

blocks.en: Figure 12 : Comparison of segmentation performance (mIoU) under different masking strengths in BRepA’s dual-MAE pretraining. Medium masking consistently achieves the best performance across different label ratios (0.5%, 1%, 10%).
blocks.zh: 图12:BREPA双MAE预训中不同遮掩优势下的分化性能(mIoU)比较. 中度遮盖在不同的标签比率(0.5%、1%、10%)方面一直取得最佳业绩。

blocks.en:
Medium masking consistently delivers the best performance across all label-ratio settings, indicating that a moderate level of corruption provides the strongest pretraining signal. Light masking fails to sufficiently challenge the model, resulting in weaker representation learning and notably lower mIoU. In contrast, heavy masking overly disrupts geometric and topological structure, causing a drop in performance compared to the medium-masking regime.
Therefore, in all subsequent experiments, we uniformly sample the mask ratio from the interval [ 0 , 0.5 ] [0,0.5] .
blocks.zh:
中度遮盖始终能在所有标签-ratio设置中提供最佳性能,表明适度程度的腐败提供了最强的预训信号. 轻口遮罩未能充分挑战模型,导致代表性学习更弱,并显著地降低mIoU. 相形之下,重口罩过度地打乱了几何和地貌结构,导致性能与中相相去甚远.
因此,在之后的所有实验中,我们统一地取样了间隔[0,0.5] [0,0.5]的口罩比.

blocks.en: B.4 Robustness of BRepA in Segmentation Training
blocks.zh: B.4 BREPA在分区培训中的实力

blocks.en:
For the segmentation experiments in the manuscript, we randomly selected labeled subsets comprising 0.10%, 0.20%, 0.50%, 1%, 10%, 20%, and 50% of the dataset.
In these experiments, BRepA with full dual MAE pretraining consistently achieved the best performance across all label ratios. To verify that these results were not influenced by the randomness of the labeled subset selection, we repeated the experiment with a 1% label ratio five times. The results are summarized in Table 6 .
The experimental results show that BRepA with dual MAE pretraining consistently achieves the best performance.
Compared to the 2D SDF SSL method [ 17 ] , it exhibits slightly lower standard deviation, indicating greater stability.
blocks.zh:
对于手稿中的分解实验,我们随机选择了由0.10%,0.20%,0.50%,1%,10%,20%和50%的数据集组成的标签子集.
在这些实验中,具有完全双重MAE预训的BREPA在所有标签比例上始终取得了最佳的性能. 为了证实这些结果没有受到被标签子集选择的随机性的影响,我们用1%的标签比重复了5次实验. 调查结果汇总于表6。
实验结果显示,具有双重MAE预训的BREPA始终达到最佳性能.
相较于2D SDF SSL方法 [17],它显示的标准偏差略低,表明稳定性较大.

blocks.en:
Table 6 : Repeated segmentation results of BRepA and baseline models on a 1% labeled subset. Each model was evaluated five times to assess robustness to the randomness of subset selection.
The table reports the mean and standard deviation of mIoU (%).
blocks.zh:
表6:BREPA和基准模型在1%标签子集上的重复分解结果. 对每个模型进行了5次评价,以评估子集选择的随机性。
该表报告了mIoU的平均与标准偏差(%).

blocks.en: B.5 Effect of the Number of Graph Layers in BRepA
blocks.zh: B.5 BREPA 图层数量的影响

blocks.en:
In the graph encoder of BRepA, we used 3 layers for both the GCN and GAT modules.
We additionally evaluate the model on the MFCAD [ 3 ] dataset with 1, 5, and 7 layers, keeping the total number of parameters approximately the same.
When using 7 layers, BRepA consistently diverges during the early stage of training.
Therefore, in Figure 13 , we only report the segmentation performance for settings with 1, 3, and 5 layers on the MFCAD dataset.
The experimental results show that using multiple graph layers (e.g., 3 or 5) improves the performance of BRepA compared to a single layer, but an excessive number of layers can lead to training instability.
blocks.zh:
在BREPA的图形编码器中,我们使用了3层的GCN和GAT两个模块.
我们还在MFCAD[3]数据集上对模型进行了1,5和7层的评估,使参数总数大致相同.
在使用7个层时,BREPA在培训的早期阶段始终存在分歧.
因此,在图13中,我们仅报告在MFCAD数据集中包含1,3和5层设置的分解性能.
实验结果显示,使用多层图层(如3或5)可以提高BREPA的性能而比出一层多,但多出多层会导致训练不稳定.

blocks.en: Figure 13 : Effect of the number of graph layers on segmentation performance of BRepA. The plot shows mIoU (%) on the MFCAD dataset for different numbers of layers in the graph encoder, evaluated under 0.5%, 1%, and 10% labeled subsets.
blocks.zh: 图13:图层数对BREPA分解性能的影响. 地块在MFCAD数据集上显示mIoU(%),用于图表编码器中不同数量层,评价在0.5%下,1%下,标签子集为10%.

blocks.en: B.6 Loss Balancing Weights
blocks.zh: B.6 平衡重量损失

blocks.en:
In Eq.11 of the manuscript, the parameter α \alpha is used to balance the geometry MAE and topology MAE.
In practice, we perform variance-based rescaling to ensure that the two MAE losses are of comparable magnitude.
blocks.zh:
在手稿的Eq.11中,参数α-α用于平衡几何MAE和地貌MAE.
在实践中,我们进行基于差异的再调整,以确保两种多物质损失具有相上可下的规模。

blocks.en:
For the generative training, since the primary objective of the diffusion model is noise prediction, we adjust the parameter β \beta in Eq.12 such that the feature alignment loss is approximately 10% of the noise prediction loss. We additionally experiment with increasing the feature alignment loss to the same magnitude as the noise prediction loss.
This only slightly accelerates the convergence of BrepDiff, but the final generative performance actually degraded, falling below that of the BrepDiff model trained without feature alignment.
blocks.zh:
对于基因训练,由于扩散模型的首要目标是噪声预测,所以我们在Eq.12中调整了参数β\β,这样特征对齐损失大约是噪声预测损失的10%. 我们还进行了实验,将特征对齐损失提高到与噪声预测损失相同的程度。
这只略为加速了BrepDiff的会合,但最终的基因性能实际上退化了,低于未受特征会合训练的BrepDiff模型.
